newsitem.title: ISRAEL: S.Africa wants Israel halt Jerusalem building plan.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa wants Israel halt Jerusalem building plan.

text.p: South Africa expressed dismay on Friday over Israeli plans to build 6,500 homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem and urged the Jewish state not to alter the status quo in the city.

"The Department of Foreign Affairs expressed its dismay at the decision by the Government of Israel to approve a major new Israeli settlement on Palestinian land," a statement released by South Africa's embassy in Israel said.

"A call was accordingly being made on the Government of Israel not to take actions which have the effect of changing the status of Jerusalem or which would prejudge outcome of final status negotiations," it said.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government gave the green light for the project on Wednesday despite warnings that construction could unleash a wave of violence. Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Thursday attacked the decision as a breach of peace agreements.
South Africa, which under apartheid had close trade and military ties with Israel, has also developed close relations with the Palestinian Authority since white rule ended in 1994.
